decisions.reason: The IMU module was launched only a year ago and its prospects are still uncertain, so the option is worth keeping open at the low cost of carrying one catalogue item, even though a bare website mention signals limited commitment.
A dedicated product page shows the firm is committing further, and an industrial AC input module fits the core I/O portfolio at low maintenance cost, so abandoning it now would be premature.
The solid state relay module is a low-cost complement to the firm's I/O modules, and too little evidence has come in to justify abandoning it after one year.

The server room monitoring kit is further from the core industrial modules and only mentioned on the website, so it is the most likely to be dropped, but its value is still unresolved and keeping it costs little.
